# The Alex Community Health Centre

> > The Alex Community Health Centre provides integrated health, housing, food security, and cultural programming in Calgary, Alberta, with a focus on Indigenous wellness and community-led care.

The Alex operates multiple sites including The Alex Community Food Centre and Isspomaanitapi Space, offering drop-in programs, traditional healing circles, youth services, and community meals. Their work is guided by a strategic plan and commitment to the United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples.

## Key Topics

- Community Health Centre
- Indigenous Culture and Wellness
- Food Security Programs
- Youth Programs (Queermunity YHC)
- Isspomaanitapi Space
- The Alex Community Food Centre
- Drop-in Services
- Traditional Healing Circles
- Red Road of Wellbriety
- Cultural Programming
- Peer Support
- Community Kitchen
- Strategic Planning
- Calgary Community Services
- 2SLGBTQIA+ Support

- [Strategic Plan](https://www.thealex.ca/impact/strategic-plan): Five-year strategic vision for The Alex's integrated care and impact

## Indigenous Cultural Programs

- [Beading with Bobby](https://www.thealex.ca/event/beading-with-bobby/2026-06-01): Traditional beading group with Bobby at Isspomaanitapi Space
- [Fire Starters Sharing Circle](https://www.thealex.ca/event/fire-starters-sharing-circle-2/2026-06-10): Indigenous healing circle for Red Road of Wellbriety community

## Community Food Programs

- [CFC Fresh & Fare Community Market & Refillery](https://www.thealex.ca/event/cfc-market-refillery/2026-03-20): Weekly affordable produce market and refillery at Community Food Centre
- [CHC Community Breakfast](https://www.thealex.ca/event/chc-community-breakfast/2026-05-19): Drop-in breakfast at The Alex Community Kitchen
- [CFC Community Lunch](https://www.thealex.ca/event/cfc-community-lunch/2026-07-08): Free drop-in lunch at Community Food Centre
- [CFC Family Dinner](https://www.thealex.ca/event/cfc-family-dinner/2026-07-06): Family-friendly drop-in dinner at Community Food Centre
- [CFC Market Prep](https://www.thealex.ca/event/market-prep/2026-03-18): Community market preparation volunteer program at Food Centre

## Youth & Social Programs

- [Queermunity YHC](https://www.thealex.ca/event/queermunity-yhc/2026-05-11): Weekly 2SLGBTQIA+ youth drop-in space, ages 12-24
- [Self Care Social Club](https://www.thealex.ca/event/self-care-social-club-2/2026-07-15): Drop-in mental wellbeing and peer support group
- [Game On!](https://www.thealex.ca/event/game-on/2026-07-14): Casual board games drop-in at Wellness Space

## Community Gatherings

- [CFC Abundant Mondays](https://www.thealex.ca/event/abundant-mondays/2026-06-29): Winter community gathering for adults, registration required
